mission: Resolve the M24 review's remaining same-question, temporal-kind, materiality, and capacity-identity objections without changing frozen scientific outcomes or adding a new corpus run.

G1.name: Make Representational Defeater explicitly relative to one identity question Q and one declared individuation criterion C

G2.name: Define substantial evidential role counterfactually rather than by an unspecified threshold

G3.name: Separate source-claim representation sensitivity from a same-question identity defeater trigger

G4.name: Demote Botvinick-Tulving from trigger evidence to a boundary case distinguishing past-directed content from process dynamics

G5.name: Add a process-level Behrens-Friston representation-sensitivity witness from pre-existing CPCG results

G6.name: Make the full learning-system counterexample explicit with state transitions, ordinary-response equivalence, intervention divergence, Q and C

G7.name: Clarify type-level capacity identity and allow functional, mechanistic, or other declared criteria without imposing one universal ontology

G8.name: Narrow Duncan-Behrens and Tulving-Patterson to auxiliary illustrations and standardize reader-facing terminology
